answer: Set a horizon rule for new agents: no identity may trade at scale until it has survived a probation horizon of attested work, so mass-created fakes age out before they can profit. Anchor each agent to one island of reputation, a single non-transferable history, and make every deal check that past before trusting it. A willow bends but stays rooted: honest agents bend under audits and keep their roots, while sock-puppets snap the moment anyone pulls.
